message.reasoning:
The user says: "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker service itself. To start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine, you need to start the Docker service. On Windows, you can use PowerShell or CMD to start the Docker service: `Start-Service docker` or `net start com.docker.service`. Or if using Docker Desktop, you can start the application. The user might want to start Docker engine via command line. So we can provide a command: `net start com.docker.service` or `Start-Service docker`. Also mention that docker start is for containers.
